pages.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTER
No. I. O. D. 1190.
Date..29....4.. 30.

April 28, 30.

Sir,

I have to acknowledge receipt of your
letter No. 224, dated April 23, 1930, enclosing
copy of a confidential order received from the
National Government, regarding a re-actionary
publication entitled "Tan Tu" ( ) Vol. 3.,
and to inform you that enquiries at stores
and agencies in the Settlement for the sale of
books have failed to reveal any trace of the
publication.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

for Commissioner of Police.

To
President,
Shanghai Special District Court.

逕覆者接奉
貴院四月廿二号
公函并附抄国民政府
命令为查禁反动刊物
坦途第三册在公共租界
发行一切刊行物广为
调查迄未查得该
反动刊物在本租界内有
何书店或机关经销售其
售价事相应函复查
由特此复
上海特区地方法院
杨院长
刑事
政治副检察长

先生：

兹确认收到阁下1930年4月23日第224号来函，随函附来国民政府关于查禁名为《坦途》（ ）第三卷之反动刊物的一道密令抄件。谨此告知，经在租界内各书店及图书代理机构进行查询，未发现该出版物的任何踪迹。

此致，
敬礼

代表警务处长

S. B. Chinese Section. April 26, 1930.

Reactionary literature.

Sir,
With reference to the attached, inquiries so far
have failed to find the alleged reactionary publication
entitled "Tan Tu" ( ) on sale at any of the book-
stores or Agencies in the Settlement, neither have we
been able to procure a copy of the publication in question.

Officer I/C
Special Branch.

Reg. letter please

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE REGISTER No. D. 1190 Date 24...4...30.）

Rough Translation of a letter No. 224 from the Shanghai Special District Court.

April 23, 1930.

Municipal Police.

Gentlemen,

I have to transmit for your information and necessary action copy of a confidential order received from the National Government through the Administrative Yuan, the Ministry of Interior Administration and the Kiangsu Provincial Government to the following effect:

"Order is hereby given that a petition has been received from the Central Propaganda Department through the Secretariat of the Central Executive Committee and the Civil Officials' Department enclosing copy of a re-actionary publication entitled Tan Tu (坦途) Vol. 3 edited by Huang Ih Eu and Cheu Tseng Ling, seized by the Tientsin Special District Kuomintang Reorganization Committee, and that strict steps should be adopted to prevent the circulation of such re-actionary printed matters."

(Chopped) The seal of Yang Shao-shun,
President of the Court.

Ch. Section,
For investigation and report please.
24/4 '30.
pages.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
处长办公室
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处登记簿 编号 D. 1190 日期 24...4...30.）

上海特区地方法院第224号来函之粗略译文。

1930年4月23日。

致工部局警务处。

诸位先生：

现转送通过行政院、内政部及江苏省政府从国民政府收到的一道密令抄件，供贵处知悉并采取必要行动，该密令内容如下：

“兹下令，已收到经由中央执行委员会秘书处及文官部转来之中央宣传部呈文，随文附天津特别区国民党改组委员会查获之由黄一欧（Huang Ih Eu）及周曾灵（Cheu Tseng Ling）编辑之反动刊物《坦途》第三卷抄件，应采取严厉措施防止此类反动印刷品之流通。”

（盖章）法院院长杨绍顺之印章。

华员股，
请调查并具报。
1930年4月24日。
